name: Université Paris-Saclay
summary: Science-led research university south of Paris; its licences, double licences and BUTs are taught in French, its English programmes are master's.

ib.text: EU/EEA nationals follow the same route as French students: apply for a first-year licence through Parcoursup. Licences are taught in French.

lastYear.text: wishes 19 January–12 March; confirm by 1 April

notes: The double-degree licences (LDD), BUTs and DEUSTs are selective first-year tracks, also applied for through Parcoursup.
Paris-Saclay's English-taught offer is at master's level; no English-taught first-year licence is listed.
